editorial: If you want a tight, scary ride that wastes no time, this one delivers. A young swimmer races into a hurricane to find her injured dad, and the two end up trapped in a flooding house. The twist? Hungry alligators have moved in with the rising water. The movie keeps things simple and mean, throwing one problem after another at you. You feel the panic as water climbs and jaws snap. The leads sell the fear and family tension without slowing the pace. It is short, loud, and fun, though the story is thin and some moments feel silly. If you like creature features and storm chaos, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final act, Haley and her dad fight through the flooded house and yard while alligators close in. They reach a boat and try to escape, but the storm worsens. Haley uses her swimming skills to lure and kill the last gator, saving her dad. They are rescued by a helicopter as the hurricane passes, battered but alive. The movie ends with them safe, hinting their bond is stronger after surviving together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creature features and storm survival stories.
